name: Cometary-Pediment
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near an ancient meteor crater.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to the starship crash site (colony ship) are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
